cdf4e98d:  ;Mumps routine to facilitate editing of VAS records
 .;
 .;Description of sections:
 .;
 .;DE - data extraction from file
 .;W - write caption for data element
 .;O - write processed data element
 .;TR - input transform
 .;A - identify next data element to edit
 .;B - branch to edit section for data element
 .;RE - re-edit data element
 .;N - validate data element for null response
 .;RD - validate data element against reader help
 .;T - validate free text data element
 .;P - call input transform
 .;V - set edited data element into local array
 .;Z - file edited data elements
821a3a92: ;call data extraction, then go to the beginning
f471ac2f: ;initialize variables for editing, extract existing data, quit if no data
94ba57b6: ;if there is a date/time field, set DE(1) to date portion
9429ee2f: ;if data element is too long, go to word wrapping routine
72b33306: ;if no editing allowed, write message and quit
703d6a81: ;get user's editing input, allow timeout for return
8a262a16: ;increment data element counter for next element to edit
bf5aad9e: ;branch to editing section for current data element
2edd0e4e: ;if data element was processed before, re-edit it
c245d873: ;check for null response if allowed
0f7cb744: ;if reader help requested, go to reader help routine
575b3d2c: ;if user entered a space and a default is available, use it
f1beb8e2: ;extract just the value portion of the processed data element
49f29e62: ;if data element has an input transform, invoke it
159aaf29: ;if numeric data element doesn't validate, go to re-edit
cc2270ec: ;branch to code specific for data element being edited
b19ca783: ;save results of editing, then identify next data element to edit
